description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that outpaces Express & Fastify with AI‑ready routing, built‑in zero‑trust security, and edge‑native performance.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.128‑daily ships with native support for next‑gen edge runtimes (Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge), AI‑ready routing that auto‑generates OpenAPI specs, and a built‑in zero‑trust security stack (CSP, rate‑limiting, JWT, CSP). All of this is delivered with zero external dependencies and full TypeScript type safety, giving developers a single‑package solution that is faster than Express/Fastify, ready for GenAI workloads, and deployable to any edge or serverless platform out‑of‑the‑box.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it eliminates the need for dozens of middleware packages—security, validation, rate‑limiting, and OpenAPI generation are built‑in.
Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency than Express/Fastify on edge runtimes, with native WASM support and zero‑dependency startup times under 5 ms.
A TypeScript‑first API with auto‑complete, VS Code Copilot integration, and AI‑driven route generation makes building, testing, and scaling services feel effortless.
